subject: Malaysia M-52 pigment for Toyo Ink Europe's review
body:
Your STERAFLEX GIO LED range includes opaque, transparent and sleeve whites.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-52 rutile TiO2 for printing inks. Its TDS provides alumina/zirconia treatment and typical oil-absorption data. UV/LED curing and migration suitability for your formulations would require separate confirmation.

May I send the M-52 technical sheet for your purchasing and technical teams' initial review?
